description: Create a BAMF image generation job. Supports quote cards, creator portraits, infographics, animated infographics (GIF + MP4 via format=motion_infographic), and package-bound LinkedIn profile banners/Featured images. Pass reference_bindings to preserve official identity/product/brand truth separately from inspiration used only for style/layout. For profile_banner/profile_featured, profile_package_id and profile_asset_kind are required; BAMF enforces one output and deterministic LinkedIn crop dimensions, then returns a durable profile_package_asset from bamf.get_job. For image_quote, create an original standalone visual quote from the post takeaway instead of asking the user to choose a pull quote or copying source text. Poll with bamf.get_job before attaching or scheduling.

engine.description: claude_design: Claude designs the visual as SVG with the creator's brand kit (real logo, colors, fonts) and BAMF renders a platform-sized PNG. Uses BAMF credits. Formats: image_quote, infographic, carousel slide.

format.description: With engine=claude_design. motion_infographic returns an animated infographic: poster PNG plus GIF and MP4 (gif_url, mp4_url on bamf.get_job), rendered by the same motion pipeline as the BAMF app.

likenessReferenceImageUrls.description: Optional creator likeness references. Defaults to the creator avatar/LinkedIn profile image when omitted.

output_formats.description: Include gif or mp4 to get the animated infographic (same as format=motion_infographic).

post_id.description: Optional draft/scheduled post to attach the first generated image to.

profile_asset_kind.description: Required for profile assets. profile_banner accepts banner; profile_featured accepts featured_1 or featured_2.

profile_package_id.description: Required for profile_banner/profile_featured. Must identify an active profile package owned by creator_id.

prompt.description: Asset brief. For visual_type=image_quote, describe the post takeaway and ask for one original, repostable quote-card thought; do not ask the user to supply a quote when post context is available.

reference_bindings.description: Resolved bamf.multimodal-reference-binding/v1 envelopes. Each item contains binding plus asset_url. Official person identity routes as likeness, other official refs preserve exact product/brand truth, and inspiration refs route only as style/layout guidance.

asset_url.description: HTTPS URL for the immutable asset version named by the binding.

binding.description: A complete bamf.multimodal-reference-binding/v1 object with consent and provenance.

research_notes.description: Concise source-backed facts to use only when they strengthen the visible copy.

source_urls.description: Source URLs for visual claims or infographic facts.

visual_copy_strategy.description: Guidance for additive visible text; image quotes should be fresh companion thoughts, not pull quotes.

name: bamf.generate_image
